publicRegressionSuite.inputs: Generated cases, WPF buttons and pinned vendor bundles. Includes interrupted recovery, changed and missing PML segments, failed event exports and delayed native diagnostic publication.

liveWindows11.workflow: Pass A reboot with WPR, followed by a second reboot with Microsoft Process Monitor 4.12 and a combined handoff. Automatic sign-in was configured on the lab VM. The lab operator steps for enabling and converting the Procmon log used the Microsoft tool.
liveWindows11.scope: PML files document Windows file operations. Trend engine durations require matched scan records within a corroborated sign-in window. Production coverage depends on the host and reproduction. The lab and referenced endpoint both use the 20.0.3.* agent family. Assess coverage on each endpoint.

previousValidation.offlineExportCheck: Verified the default xperf reports and an initial-window disk summary using a Windows lab ETL.
previousValidation.otherScenarios: Separate earlier captures exercised same-boot sign-in, reboot and recovery.

checks: Displayed the prepared Pass A and Pass B instructions in WPF at the minimum supported window size.
Exercised the readiness decision with Windows fixtures for a new pair, a retry, attempts without a pair, an occupied console, sign-in during the check and the same-boot scenario.
Ran the actual signed Windows control and read generated log records split across a rotation within the same millisecond. The exact test file matched and its temporary directory was removed.
coldSignInReadiness.priorLabObservation: DSA 20.0.3-31610. An immediate sign-in had zero scan starts from authentication through Explorer. With the credential screen held, unique signed probes were observed before authentication. The later sign-in recorded 190 scan starts across 184 paths from authentication through Explorer. All 190 had a completion and 189 completed within that interval.
coldSignInReadiness.scope: The lab reboot comparison preceded this CLI stage. The new stage itself was exercised with controlled inputs. No minimum delay or guaranteed sign-in coverage was established.

delayedSignInPilot.conditions: Separate manual pilot, local Windows sign-in two minutes after the credential screen appeared.
delayedSignInPilot.scope: One observed local sign-in. The timing and scan coverage can differ on another boot or computer.

liveRebootCheck.conditions: Separate reboot with automatic Windows sign-in. The collector reopened in the local administrator desktop and Stop trace now saved the WPR file.
liveRebootCheck.scope: The watcher also picks up surviving rotations when Windows starts the task late. Retired generations can already be gone.
